title: Add position_limits field to Account and Reason.POSITION_LIMIT (no behavior change)
acceptance: Account has `position_limits: dict[str, Decimal]` with default_factory=dict, declared AFTER `positions` so the existing positional call Account(id, margin, positions) still works and `position_limits=` is accepted as keyword
validate_order is unchanged; all of tests/ and invariants/test_order_invariants.py still pass
Unit test confirms Account defaults to empty position_limits and that two Accounts do not share the same dict
No float used anywhere; invariants/, factory.toml, CODEOWNERS and .github/ untouched

title: Enforce per-symbol position limit in validate_order for exposure-increasing orders only
acceptance: Add a small typed helper (e.g. `_breaches_position_limit(order, account) -> bool`) in orders/validation.py; the logic is: limit = account.position_limits.get(symbol); if limit is None return False; current = account.positions.get(symbol, Decimal(0)); new = current + signed_qty(order); breach only if abs(new) > abs(current) AND abs(new) > limit
Check runs after the structural checks (instrument/qty/lot/tick) and returns exactly one Reason.POSITION_LIMIT rejection; it is placed with the risk checks
Missing symbol in position_limits means no limit; a missing position is treated as Decimal(0)
Exactly at the limit is accepted (abs(new) == limit), one lot step over is rejected
Reducing or closing orders are never rejected with POSITION_LIMIT, including when the account is already over the limit (e.g. pos=+300, limit=100, SELL 1 is accepted)
A flip order (e.g. long 5 -> SELL 12 gives -7, limit 10) is accepted when abs(new) <= limit, and rejected when abs(new) > limit and abs(new) > abs(current)

New tests in tests/test_validation.py cover BUY and SELL, long and short and flat positions, at-limit, over-limit, reducing while over-limit, flip across zero, no limit configured, and limit for a different symbol only
validate_order does not mutate account or order (compare before/after in a test)
`python -m pytest -q tests/` and `python -m pytest -q invariants/` both pass (including invariants/test_position_limit_invariants.py); change is under ~100 lines
